command: set -euo pipefail; VP=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID --value); CP=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p MainPID --value); echo "VOICE_PID=$VP CLIENT_PID=$CP"; echo '===VOICE_CONFIG==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ExecStart -p Environment -p ActiveState -p SubState -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --no-pager; echo '===VOICE_PROCESS==='; if [ "${VP:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then printf 'cmdline='; tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$VP/cmdline; echo; ps -o pid=,ppid=,stat=,etime=,cmd= -p "$VP"; pgrep -P "$VP" -a || true; fi; echo '===VOICE_SOCKETS==='; ss -ntp 2>/dev/null | grep -E "pid=($VP|$CP)," || true; echo '===FILES==='; P=$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts; for f in voice_final_runtime.py voice_full_runtime.py omega_runtime.py frankenstein_identity_assembly.py omega_arm_bus.py omega_organ_activity.py voice_host_777_live_client.py voice_777_runtime.py; do if [ -f "$P/$f" ]; then sha256sum "$P/$f"; else echo "MISSING $P/$f"; fi; done; echo '===CLI==='; command -v omega || true; [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/omega" ] && "$HOME/.local/bin/omega" selftest || true; echo '===RECENT_UNIT_HEALTH==='; journalctl --user -u frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -n 30 --no-pager -o cat 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(OMEGA|FranKenstein|Realtime|Voice|ERROR|Error|Traceback|Exception|Verbunden|Getrennt|Listener|Wake|Session|999|777|Start|Stop|Listening|WebSocket)' || true
